script_text: Stop, Taurus — the cosmos is throwing a curveball at you today that demands your immediate attention! Venus, your ruling planet and earth element master, is forming a challenging square with Mars in your 6th House of Daily Work, creating intense tension between your desire for comfort and the push for action. This grounding energy is clashing with fiery impulsiveness in ways that feel deeply uncomfortable. If you're single, this tension could attract someone who challenges your stubborn nature in unexpected ways. If taken, avoid power struggles over household routines today — patience is your only shield. Your 10th House of Career is receiving a supportive trine from Jupiter, opening doors for recognition you've been working toward for months. This transit favors bold moves in the public eye — trust this momentum completely. Don't let perfectionism sabotage a golden opportunity that presents itself before noon. Subscribe so you don't miss what's coming this week for Taurus.
